echoParts: A new commandment I give you
verseText: A new commandment I give you: Love one another. As I have loved you, so you also must love one another.
meaning: Jesus commands us to love each other like he loved us, and he loved us enough to give his life in our place.

recall.question: What new commandment did Jesus give His followers?
choices: Love your friends, hate your enemies

meaning.question: Jesus tells us to love one another as He loved us. How did Jesus love us?
choices: He gave his life to save us
He wrote a book of the Bible
He loved us after we loved him first

application.prompt: Jesus didn't just tell us to love others, He showed us what love looked like by giving His life for us! Think about how Jesus has loved you, and look for ways to show that same love to others!
